question_cn: 后对快要升变的兵（如兵在第7排），白方（有后一方）的主要手段是：
question_en: Queen vs. pawn about to promote (pawn on 7th rank) — White's (the queen side's) main approach is:

options.text_cn: 用后将军迫使对方王走开（通常需要几方王的协助），再将兵吃掉或阻止升变
options.text_en: Check the king repeatedly to prevent promotion or win the pawn
Queen just captures the pawn directly
Wait for own king to approach before acting

options.text_cn: 后无法应对快要升变的兵
options.text_en: The queen cannot handle a pawn about to promote

explanation_cn: 后对升变兵的核心元思维：后通过连续将军迫使对方王暴露，同时己方王快速靠近。这需要精确计算，因为c兵、f兵的升变格特殊（后可能遭遇逼和陷阱）。
explanation_en: Core meta-concept: queen gives perpetual checks forcing the enemy king to expose itself while own king rushes in. Beware of c-pawn and f-pawn stalemate traps.
